entries.name: Broodfather
entries.content: A broodfather is the term for a male dinosaur capable of laying eggs. Not all dinosaur men can lay eggs. Only broodfathers can lay actual, fertile eggs, and that is a rare trait. As a result, broodfathers are extremely valuable and are highly coveted. They are often fought over, or used in trades between peaceful tribes.

entries.name: Tribal rituals
entries.content:

- Humiliation rituals, where a warring tribe will parade its captured enemies around and humiliate them
- Coming of age rituals, usually involving tons of hot gay sex to break in virgins who have come of age
- Fertility festivals, such as annual celebratory gangbangs of a tribe's broodfathers

entries.name: Religion
entries.content:
Almost every dinosaur on Earth worships the large, glowing ball in the sky that comes out at night. It goes by many names:
- The Great One
- The Great Ball
- Lord of the Sea, Land and Air
- The Glowing One
- The Moon
The Great Ball is said to bless broodfathers with the gift of fertility, and to be the sole reason they can bear and lay eggs.
